validation.nameTooLong: Each name part must be 80 characters or fewer, and the combined name must be 200 or fewer.

branches.label: Branches
branches.title: Main branch and hours

branches.name: Branch name

privacy.securityBody: Company access is limited by sign-in, role permissions, and company membership. The public site is intended to be served over HTTPS by its host. This page does not claim a specific encryption algorithm, encryption at rest, or a security certification.
privacy.contactBody: For privacy questions or a deletion request, email {{email}} or use mobile {{phone}}. You can also open the Data Deletion page. Do not include passwords or access tokens.
privacy.childrenBody: ValueOR is a business workspace. It is not directed to children and does not offer a children's account.
privacy.internationalBody: Hosting and connected providers may process data outside the country where the company operates. That processing is subject to those providers' terms and tooling.
privacy.metaP1: When communication channels such as WhatsApp, Instagram, and others are connected to ValueOR, related data may be processed, including message content, phone numbers, account identifiers, attachments, message statuses, and metadata needed to provide the service.
privacy.metaP2: This data is used to provide inbound messaging, authorized replies, conversation management, customer support, automation, and other features the customer enables.
privacy.metaP3: When AI features are used, relevant content may be shared with OpenAI as described in the AI data-processing section of this policy.
privacy.metaP4: Processing through these channels is also subject to the terms and policies of the relevant providers.
privacy.aiP1: Some ValueOR features may use artificial intelligence provided through OpenAI APIs. When an authorized user uses one of these features, relevant content—such as message text, conversation context, or data needed to fulfill the request—may be shared with OpenAI to process the request and return the required result.
privacy.aiP2: Within ValueOR, use of this data is limited to providing the AI feature the user requested, according to account permissions and service settings. Processing by OpenAI is subject to that provider's applicable terms, policies, and API account settings.
privacy.aiP3: ValueOR does not make guarantees about how long OpenAI retains data or whether OpenAI uses it for training, except to the extent confirmed by the actual terms and settings of the service in use.
privacy.providersAi: OpenAI and related APIs when an authorized user uses ValueOR AI features.
privacy.retentionP1: ValueOR retains data for as long as there is an operational, contractual, or legal need to keep it, or until a valid deletion request is processed under the applicable procedures.
privacy.retentionP2: Deletion requests are handled manually by ValueOR administration after the request is reviewed and the requester's identity and authority are verified. Some data may be retained where legal or accounting obligations apply, or where retention is needed for security, fraud prevention, or dispute resolution.
privacy.retentionP3: Backups, operational logs, and data processed by external providers may be subject to those providers' own retention policies and procedures.
privacy.deletionP1: A user or an authorized company representative may submit a data deletion request through the data deletion page at https://www.valueor.org/data-deletion or by email at valueor@admin.org.
privacy.deletionP2: Requests are reviewed manually by ValueOR administration. The requester may be asked for additional information to verify identity or authority.
privacy.deletionP3: After verification, administration processes deletion of data held in systems ValueOR controls, subject to any legal or accounting obligations or other legitimate retention requirements.
privacy.deletionP4: Submitting a request does not mean deletion is automatic or immediate. ValueOR does not guarantee deletion of data controlled by Meta, OpenAI, or another external provider. A separate request to the relevant provider may be required.
privacy.useSecurity: Security, troubleshooting, abuse prevention, auditability, and operating the service.

dataDeletion.requestBody: There is no self-serve wipe of a company workspace on this page. Email {{email}} or call {{phone}}. Use the subject "ValueOR data deletion request" so the message can be recognized.
dataDeletion.afterP1: Requests are reviewed manually by ValueOR administration. The requester may be asked for additional information to verify identity or authority.
dataDeletion.afterP2: After verification, administration processes deletion of data held in systems ValueOR controls, subject to any legal or accounting obligations or other legitimate retention requirements.
dataDeletion.afterP3: Submitting a request does not mean deletion is automatic or immediate. ValueOR does not guarantee deletion of data controlled by Meta, OpenAI, or another external provider. A separate request to the relevant provider may be required.

terms.contactBody: Questions about these Terms can be sent to {{email}} or {{phone}}.
terms.liabilityBody: ValueOR is provided as the software currently operates. This page is not a warranty statement and does not set a liability cap.
terms.availabilityBody: The service can be interrupted by hosting, database, or third-party channel outages. Features can change. These Terms can be updated on this page. No uptime percentage is promised.

platformAdmin.banner: You are administering {{company}} as a platform administrator. Your own account is unchanged.
platformAdmin.deniedTitle: This company workspace is not available to this account
platformAdmin.deniedBody: The hostname does not match your company, or the company is not active. Platform administration stays on the app host.
platformAdmin.forbidden: This account is not a member of the company for this hostname.
